compiled.draft: During a declared emergency, health message logs may be stored at a backup site abroad for 72 hours.
compiled.rationale: The provision directly maps to the 'emergency_offshore_exception' mechanism with a specified time limit.

conflicts.note: Article 13 permits offshore processing only where a resolution is issued by the Health Authority in coordination with the Ministry.
conflicts.verbatim: It is not permissible to store, process, generate or transform the health data and information outside State -which are related to the health services provided inside State- except in the case where a resolution is issued from the Health Authority in coordination with the Ministr
